Friday - April 13th

6:00pm Notified by gas control that we needed to deliver to Centana for operational reasons, approx. 30-50 MMBTU rate.  Contacted Carlos to see if it was possible since we are over are storage capacity at Centana...he spoke with Ron with Centana and it was approved.  

Saturday - April 14th

8:30am  Notified by gas control that the Freeport delivery to Dow was increased to 10.0.  Also, Exxon Katy was over delivering approx. 7-9 MMBTU, and they had over delivered a similar volume on Friday.  Confrimed with Jackie that it was ok for Saturday.

Sunday - April 15th  

No calls - except from the Easter Bunny!
